pointers.sentence: `django.contrib.staticfiles.views.serve` takes a request and a path relative to `STATIC_URL` (`django/contrib/staticfiles/views.py:serve`).

It passes its prefix, `STATIC_URL` unless another is given, and this view to `django.conf.urls.static.static`, so it refuses an empty prefix and returns an empty list unless `settings.DEBUG` is true and the prefix names no host (`django/contrib/staticfiles/urls.py:staticfiles_urlpatterns`, `django/conf/urls/static.py:static`).

It passes its prefix, `STATIC_URL` unless another is given, and this view to `django.conf.urls.static.static`, so it refuses an empty prefix and returns an empty list unless `settings.DEBUG` is true and the prefix names no host (`django/contrib/staticfiles/urls.py:staticfiles_urlpatterns`, `django/conf/urls/static.py:static`).
Its module is a URLconf as well: when it is first imported with `settings.DEBUG` true, its own list of patterns receives the same pattern (`django/contrib/staticfiles/urls.py`).

`StaticFilesHandler.__call__` reads the path from the environ, and unless `StaticFilesHandlerMixin._should_handle` finds it under the path of `STATIC_URL`, with no host in `STATIC_URL`, it calls the application inside, untouched (`django/contrib/staticfiles/handlers.py:StaticFilesHandler.__call__`).

`StaticFilesHandlerMixin.load_middleware`, which `WSGIHandler.__init__` calls, does nothing; the comment says the middleware are already loaded for the application inside (`django/contrib/staticfiles/handlers.py:StaticFilesHandlerMixin.load_middleware`).

An `Http404` becomes a response through `response_for_exception`: the project's 404 view, or the technical 404 page while `settings.DEBUG` is true (`django/contrib/staticfiles/handlers.py:StaticFilesHandlerMixin.get_response`).

And only `Http404` is caught: the `SuspiciousFileOperation` a finder raises for a path that climbs out of its directory, which the project's chain would have made a 400, leaves the handler for the server (`django/core/handlers/exception.py:response_for_exception`).

Closing the response sends `request_finished` with the handler's class as its sender: `StaticFilesHandler` for the static files of the run, `WSGIHandler` for the lighthouse (`django/http/response.py:HttpResponseBase.close`).

That raises `ImproperlyConfigured` for a `STATIC_URL` not set (an empty one becomes the script prefix, ordinarily `"/"`, under which every path falls), a `MEDIA_URL` equal to it, a `MEDIA_ROOT` and a `STATIC_ROOT` both set and equal, and, while `settings.DEBUG` is true, a `MEDIA_URL` inside `STATIC_URL`, whose paths the handler would take for its own (`django/contrib/staticfiles/utils.py:check_settings`, `django/conf/__init__.py:LazySettings._add_script_prefix`).

`ASGIStaticFilesHandler.__call__` keeps a scope of the type `"http"` whose path is under `STATIC_URL`, for `ASGIHandler.__call__`, and passes every other, a lifespan or a WebSocket among them, to the application inside (`django/contrib/staticfiles/handlers.py:ASGIStaticFilesHandler.__call__`).

`ASGIStaticFilesHandler.get_response_async` then replaces the synchronous iterator of a streaming response, such as the view's `FileResponse`, with an asynchronous generator that first reads all of it in a thread; its comment says `FileResponse` is not async compatible (`django/contrib/staticfiles/handlers.py:ASGIStaticFilesHandler.get_response_async`).

It adds `--nostatic` and `--insecure`, and its `Command.get_handler` wraps what Django's returns, the project's WSGI application, in a `StaticFilesHandler`, unless `--nostatic` was given, if `settings.DEBUG` is true or `--insecure` was given (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/runserver.py:Command.get_handler`).
`--insecure` serves files by the names they are kept under, and the documentation says it does not work with `ManifestStaticFilesStorage` (`docs/ref/contrib/staticfiles.txt`).

`StaticLiveServerTestCase` overrides `LiveServerTestCase.static_handler`, a private handler that serves `STATIC_ROOT`, with `StaticFilesHandler`, so a live server's static files come from the finders, with nothing collected (`django/contrib/staticfiles/testing.py:StaticLiveServerTestCase`, `django/test/testcases.py:_StaticFilesHandler`) ([A server in a thread: `LiveServerTestCase`](../testing/live-server.md)).
